arxiv-1804-03682.title: Search for \ttbar ​ \PH \ttbar\PH production in the \PH → \bbbar \PH\to\bbbar decay channel with leptonic \ttbar decays in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-1804-03682.description: Abstract A search is presented for the associated production of a standard model Higgs boson with a top quark-antiquark pair ( \ttbar ​ \PH \ttbar\PH ), in which the Higgs boson decays into a \PQb quark-antiquark pair, in proton-proton collisions at a centre-of-mass energy s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV . The data correspond to an integrated luminosity of 35.

arxiv-2106-11409.title: Learn Like The Pro: Norms from Theory to Size Neural Computation Thanks: Corresponding Author: ravela@mit.edu
arxiv-2106-11409.creator: Margaret Trautner, Ziwei Li, Sai Ravela
arxiv-2106-11409.description: Abstract The optimal design of neural networks is a critical problem in many applications. Here, we investigate how dynamical systems with polynomial nonlinearities can inform the design of neural systems that seek to emulate them. We propose a Learnability metric and its associated features to quantify the near-equilibrium behavior of learning dynamics.

arxiv-2112-05120.title: On Convergence of Federated Averaging Langevin Dynamics
arxiv-2112-05120.creator: Wei Deng, Qian Zhang, Yi-An Ma, Zhao Song, Guang Lin
arxiv-2112-05120.description: Abstract We propose a federated averaging Langevin algorithm (FA-LD) for uncertainty quantification and mean predictions with distributed clients. In particular, we generalize beyond normal posterior distributions and consider a general class of models. We develop theoretical guarantees for FA-LD for strongly log-concave distributions with non-i.i.

arxiv-2308-13843.title: Shape dimension of maps
arxiv-2308-13843.creator: Pavel S. Gevorgyan, I. Pop
arxiv-2308-13843.description: Abstract . In this paper we define a numerical shape invariant of a continuous map called shape dimension of a map, which generalizes the shape dimension of a topological space. Some basic properties and applications of this invariant are given. The question of raising the shape dimension by shape finite-dimensional maps is solved.

arxiv-2409-15164.title: Reliable and Secure Communications Through Compact Ultra-Massive Antenna Arrays
arxiv-2409-15164.creator: José David Vega-Sánchez, Member, IEEE, Henry Ramiro Carvajal Mora, Senior Member, IEEE, Nathaly Verónica Orozco Garzón, Senior Member, IEEE, F. J. López-Martínez, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2409-15164.description: Abstract Compact Ultramassive Antenna Array (CUMA) is a pioneering paradigm that leverages the flexibility of the Fluid Antenna System (FAS) to enable a simple multiple access scheme for massive connectivity without the need for precoding, power control at the base station or interference mitigation in each user’s equipment.

arxiv-2410-13663.title: DiRecNetV2: A Transformer-Enhanced Network for Aerial Disaster Recognition
arxiv-2410-13663.creator: Demetris Shianios, Panayiotis S. Kolios, Christos Kyrkou*
arxiv-2410-13663.description: Abstract The integration of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) with artificial intelligence (AI) models for aerial imagery processing in disaster assessment, necessitates models that demonstrate exceptional accuracy, computational efficiency, and real-time processing capabilities. Traditionally Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), demonstrate efficiency in local feature extraction but are limited by their potential for global context interpretation.

arxiv-2505-24095.title: SkyLB: A Locality-Aware Cross-Region Load Balancer for LLM Inference
arxiv-2505-24095.creator: Tian Xia † Ziming Mao † Jamison Kerney † Ethan J. Jackson †‡ Zhifei Li †§ Jiarong Xing †¶ Scott Shenker †⋄ Ion Stoica † † UC Berkeley ‡ Aviatrix § Renmin University of China ¶ Rice University ⋄ ICSI
arxiv-2505-24095.description: Abstract . Serving Large Language Models (LLMs) efficiently in multi-region setups remains a challenge. Due to cost and GPU availability concerns, providers typically deploy LLMs in multiple regions using instance with long-term commitments, like reserved instances or on-premise clusters, which are often underutilized due to their region-local traffic handling and diurnal traffic variance.

arxiv-2507-00594.title: Neural translation for Stokes inversion and synthesis
arxiv-2507-00594.creator: A. Asensio Ramos, J. de la Cruz Rodríguez
arxiv-2507-00594.description: Abstract Context. The physical conditions in stellar atmospheres, such as temperature, velocity, and magnetic fields, can be obtained from the interpretation of solar spectro-polarimetric observations. However, traditional inversion codes, while successful, are computationally demanding, especially for lines whose formation is complex and dictated by non-local thermodynamical equilibrium effects.

arxiv-2509-14812.title: From Hitchin Systems to Rational Elliptic Surfaces with ℂ ∗ \mathbb{C}^{*} -actions via Orbifold Hilbert Schemes
arxiv-2509-14812.creator: Yonghong Huang
arxiv-2509-14812.description: Abstract Using orbifold Hilbert schemes, we compactify all two-dimensional Hitchin systems corresponding to A ~ 0 \widetilde{A}_{0} , D ~ 4 \widetilde{D}_{4} , E ~ 6 \widetilde{E}_{6} , E ~ 7 \widetilde{E}_{7} , and E ~ 8 \widetilde{E}_{8} , thereby obtaining four rational elliptic surfaces with ℂ ∗ \mathbb{C}^{*} -actions.

pmc-10544898.title: Renal involvement in eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis
pmc-10544898.creator: Francesco Reggiani, Vincenzo L’Imperio, Marta Calatroni, Fabio Pagni, Renato Alberto Sinico
pmc-10544898.description: Eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA) is a necrotizing vasculitis, which typically affects small-to medium-sized blood vessels. It is characterized by the presence of tissue infiltrates rich in eosinophils, along with the formation of granulomatous lesions. About 40% of cases have positive anti-neutrophil cytoplasm antibodies (ANCA), with predominant perinuclear staining, and anti-myeloperoxidase (anti-MPO) specificity in about 65% of cases.

pmc-10878490.title: Health facility-based interventions and the uptake of contraception among people living with HIV: A systematic review & meta-analysis
pmc-10878490.creator: R Revathy, Himanshu Chaurasia, Siddesh Shetty, Beena Joshi
pmc-10878490.description: Background & objectives:The prong 2 of 4 prong strategy introduced by the World Health Organization aims at averting unintended pregnancies among people living with HIV (PLHIV). This systematic review aimed to generate evidence on the effectuality of facility-based interventions in improving uptake of modern and dual contraception, for reducing unmet family planning (FP) needs and unintended pregnancies among PLHIV.

pmc-11498729.title: Identification of risk factors and establishment of prediction models for mortality risk in patients with acute kidney injury: A retrospective cohort study
pmc-11498729.creator: Shengtao Li, Zhanzhan Li, Yanyan Li, Vipa Thanachartwet, Vipa Thanachartwet, Vipa Thanachartwet
pmc-11498729.description: This study investigated factors influencing death in patients with Acute Kidney Injury (AKI) and developed models to predict their mortality risk. We analyzed data from 1079 AKI patients admitted to Changsha First Hospital using a retrospective design. Patient information including demographics, medical history, lab results, and treatments were collected.

pmc-11557781.title: How Are We Addressing Axial Psoriatic Arthritis in Clinical Practice?
pmc-11557781.creator: Xabier Michelena, Clementina López-Medina, Eugenio De Miguel, Manuel José Moreno-Ramos, Rubén Queiro, Helena Marzo-Ortega, Xavier Juanola
pmc-11557781.description: Psoriatic arthritis (PsA) is a chronic inflammatory disease affecting the musculoskeletal system, skin and nails. In addition to peripheral joints, inflammation of the spine and sacroiliac joints may occur. Yet, research into this axial phenotype has lagged behind partly because of the challenge in its clinical identification with a lack of specific clinical, molecular or imaging biomarkers.

pmc-12657888.title: A user-driven consent platform for health data sharing in digital health applications
pmc-12657888.creator: Stefanie Brückner, Akrem Dridi, Aniruddha Deshmukh, Toralf Kirsten, Anne Lauber-Rönsberg, Ronja Riedel, Sven Hetmank, Cindy Welzel, Stephen Gilbert
pmc-12657888.description: Wearable and health app data hold significant potential for healthcare and research, yet fragmented consent mechanisms create challenges for ethical, transparent, and user-controlled data sharing. We describe a centralised consent management system with a structured approach to standardising health data sharing, ensuring regulatory compliance and improving user autonomy.

pmc-12800086.title: Ustekinumab may have therapeutic effects on autoimmune thyroid disease
pmc-12800086.creator: Suleyman Sami Guzel, Ahmet Numan Demir, Tugce Eskazan, Ali Ibrahim Hatemi, Mustafa Sait Gonen
pmc-12800086.description: Interleukin (IL)-12 and IL-23 play crucial roles in initiating and maintaining autoimmunity, which is implicated in autoimmune thyroid disease (AITD). This study evaluated the effect of ustekinumab, a biologic agent targeting IL-12/23, on AITD in patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).

pmc-12827063.title: Drug shortage in South Korea: machine learning-based prediction models and analysis of duration and causal factors
pmc-12827063.creator: Hyun Soo Roe, Da Eun Ko, Seo Yun Nam, Jae Eun Oh, Su Min Park, Se Hee Lee, Jong Hyuk Lee
pmc-12827063.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundDrug shortages remain a critical challenge for healthcare systems in South Korea. This study aimed to develop predictive models to forecast drug shortage duration and identify their underlying causes.MethodsUsing 1,054 regulatory-reported drug shortage cases from 2018 to 2024 obtained from the Korean Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (KMFDS), we developed two machine learning models: (1) Model 1 to estimate shortage duration ranges, and (2) Model 2 to classify shortage causes into seven categories.

pmc-13242779.title: A Tool for Predicting Disability Pension Applications in the Finnish Public Sector: Sickness Absences as Early Indicators of Declining Work Ability
pmc-13242779.creator: Petra Sohlman
pmc-13242779.description: PurposeIdentifying employees at the greatest risk of work disability is critical to preventing early exit from the labor market. Understanding how different factors influence work disability risk in the years leading to a pension is important in preventing early exits.

pmc-13333516.title: Therapeutic progress in rosacea: targeting the neuro-vascular-immune triad
pmc-13333516.creator: Xingyin Yang, Wanqing Yang, Nuoran Chen, Dansheng Li, Yang Xu

pmc-13415694.title: Case Report: Early-onset psychosis as a sentinel manifestation of 3q29 deletion syndrome in an adolescent with neurodevelopmental disorders
pmc-13415694.creator: W. Vidal, B. Masotto, M. Viñas-Jornet, J. A. Ramos-Quiroga, G. Español-Martín
pmc-13415694.description: Background3q29 deletion syndrome is a rare genomic disorder characterized by a broad spectrum of neurodevelopmental and psychiatric manifestations, including developmental delay (DD), intellectual disability (ID), autism spectrum disorder (ASD), attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and a markedly increased lifetime risk of psychosis and schizophrenia.

pmc-13597668.title: Finite element analysis of medial meniscus tears and related surgical techniques with biomechanical validation
pmc-13597668.creator: Chengyue Yu, Kexin Liu, Jingyu Zhang, Wenjun Zhao, Xiaoyuan Duan, Bo Liu, Lupeng Wang, Zhao Liu, Yongxin Huo, Tao Zhang, Guosheng Xing, Weiguo Xu
pmc-13597668.description: IntroductionThis study established finite element models of the knee incorporating radial and longitudinal meniscal tears and simulated corresponding surgical techniques to investigate the influence of different tear types, lengths, locations on stress distribution in the knee joint and evaluate the restorative effects of different surgical techniques on the biomechanical performance of the meniscus.

pmc-13677465.title: Vedolizumab treatment in adults with immunodeficiency-associated enteropathy: a case series
pmc-13677465.creator: Ernestina Angarola, María Josefina Etchevers, Juan Andres De Paula, Maria Florencia Sanchez, Juan Pablo Santino, Diana Liberatore
pmc-13677465.description: BackgroundInflammatory gastrointestinal disease is a common manifestation of inborn errors of immunity (IEI) and may affect any segment of the gastrointestinal tract. Vedolizumab, a gut-selective anti-integrin approved for inflammatory bowel disease, has been scarcely studied in IEI. We describe our experience with vedolizumab in adults with immunodeficiency-associated enteropathy.
